name: Sage Lodge
positioning: Montana resort on the banks of the Yellowstone River, 35 minutes north of Yellowstone National Park, with over 1,200 acres to explore
best_for: Travelers who want a base for Yellowstone National Park tours
Anglers who want fly fishing in the heart of Montana's fly fishing country
Families and groups who want a free-standing Ranch House with separate guestrooms

facts.text: Sage Lodge is located on the banks of the Yellowstone River.
Sage Lodge is 35 minutes north of Yellowstone National Park.
The property has over 1,200 acres to explore.
Sage Lodge was awarded Three MICHELIN Keys for the third year in a row by the 2026 MICHELIN Guide.
Lodge King rooms have a gas fireplace and a balcony or patio with views of Emigrant Peak.
Lodge Deluxe Window King rooms have a window seat for taking in Emigrant Peak views.
Each full Ranch House has four separate guestrooms, each with a private bathroom.
On-site fly fishing is available year round.
The Sage Lodge Junior Rangers program is available year round for ages 5 and up.
The restaurants serve house-cured meats from local ranches and garden-fresh produce from nearby farms.
The Fireside Room Backcountry Menu offers breakfast and lunch picnic options for in-house guests.

highlights.text: There are four free-standing Ranch Houses on the south end of the property.
Lodge Double Queen rooms have a private balcony overlooking Paradise Valley and the Absaroka and Gallatin mountain ranges.
Yellowstone National Park Tours are included with a stay in spring, summer and fall.
Yellowstone River scenic floats are included with a stay in spring, summer and fall.
Lodge Paradise King rooms have a wet bar and a private patio with an outdoor fireplace.

considerations.text: Sage Lodge is in a rural location.
Advance reservations are strongly recommended, especially for Yellowstone Tours and Fly Fishing, and some adventures are weather-dependent.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury wilderness resort positioning.
